description.value: HiFive Chicken is a Vancouver-born Canadian fast food chain founded in 2016, now operating over 11 locations across British Columbia. The menu centres on roasted and fried chicken in pieces, sandwiches, tenders, and wings, rounded out by sides like Canuck poutine, biscuits, and mashed potatoes. A loyalty cashback app and online ordering make it a straightforward resupply stop for cyclists moving through the Lower Mainland.
